hypothesis: P195's matched sector rebalancing premium is invariant to calendar phase rather than being an artifact of month-end execution.
predeclared_gate: At 2010+ and 2015+, all three fixed phases must have positive matched CAGR excess; at least two of three phases must exceed +0.50 pp CAGR matched excess from 2010; no phase may have Sharpe more than 0.10 below its matched control.
launch_condition: Launch only if P197 leave-one-sector-out robustness does not establish thesis-critical fragility that makes calendar-phase adjudication low-value.
